title: Leveraging Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Culturally Inclusive Hakka Chatbots: Design Insights and User Perceptions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the cultural inclusivity and accuracy of a RAG-enhanced chatbot tailored to the Taiwanese Hakka minority culture using user feedback surveys and the System Usability Scale (SUS) to measure improvements over standard, generic LLMs.

Assessing the system's ability to handle low-resource minority language queries by evaluating user interactions, translation accuracy, and character recognition in the Hakka language using system usability scoring.
